description: This file contains implementation of generic connection-related functions for network protocols in Zephyr OS, including connection registration, input processing, and management of connection handlers.

methods.name: conn_get_unused
methods.description: Retrieves an unused connection structure from the pool.

methods.name: conn_set_used
methods.description: Marks a connection as used and adds it to the used list.

methods.name: conn_set_unused
methods.description: Resets a connection and adds it back to the unused list.

methods.name: conn_find_handler
methods.description: Finds an existing connection handler matching specified criteria.

methods.name: net_conn_change_callback
methods.description: Updates the callback and user data for a connection.

methods.name: net_conn_change_remote
methods.description: Updates remote address and port of a connection.

methods.name: net_conn_register
methods.description: Registers a new connection handler with specified parameters.

methods.name: conn_addr_cmp
methods.description: Compares packet addresses with connection addresses for matching.

methods.name: conn_send_icmp_error
methods.description: Sends ICMP error messages for unreachable destinations.

methods.name: conn_are_endpoints_valid
methods.description: Validates if packet endpoints are appropriate for connection.

methods.name: conn_raw_socket
methods.description: Handles raw socket packets matching connection criteria.
